deadline_text: The 2026 application window was Jan 5 to Mar 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: SPEAK Student Volunteers (Atlanta Botanical Garden)

deadline_text: The Garden says to check back in December 2026 for Summer 2027 details.

name: Student Business Shadow Project (SBSP)

deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted on the page.

deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page.

deadline_text: The page lists separate volunteer forms for each type of work. It does not say when applications are taken.

what_you_do: Paid internships and job training. They match Duval County students with local employers.

what_you_do: Help at a library branch with events, crafts and everyday tasks, and earn service hours.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline. It says the library gets more applicants than openings.

deadline_text: Applications open every year on November 1 and close November 25. They are closed until then.

what_you_do: Shelve and sort library items. Sort donated books, help staff and get crafts ready for children's programs.
deadline_text: Apply any time through a branch.

deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 year closed August 24, 2026. Watch the page for the next year.

name: North Miami Youth Council

deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, September 4, 2026. Watch the page for the next call.

what_you_do: Join teen volunteer events like craft kits and trying out classes. Make a literary magazine, or join online advisory boards. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Register for upcoming events at participating branches.

name: Catalyst Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Work with kids and families in the exhibit halls and run science activities. Build leadership and teamwork skills.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are closed. The page says to check back in the new year for the 2027 Summer Session.

deadline_text: The 2026 summer cohort application is closed. Open houses ran March 9 to 12, 2026 at city neighborhood centers. Expect a similar spring window for 2027 (not posted).

city: Orlando, Lake Nona, Lake Baldwin, Viera and Daytona, FL

deadline_text: In 2026 applications were accepted on one day only, April 15, 2026, by email. Expect a similar one day window in spring 2027, not yet posted.

name: Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one shift a week in the hospital. You help comfort patients and help other teams. Career ideas are part of the program.
deadline_text: Applications are due by noon on March 1 (start by May 1) and July 1 (start by Sept 1). The page gives no year.

name: Teen Advisory and Advocacy Board
what_you_do: Give the library feedback on teen programs, speak up for teens, and write monthly reflections. Finishers earn up to 100 service hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 board (July 8 to November 7) is filled. The page says to check back for a future chance to apply.

name: Mayor's Youth Corps
what_you_do: A group of teens that lasts a year. They talk with the Mayor, learn how city government works and do hands on service for the community.
deadline_text: The page links to a Class of 2027 application but gives no open or close dates.

what_you_do: Learn from Tampa police officers. Get hands on practice in law enforcement. Build leadership and teamwork. Finish volunteer hours in the community.
deadline_text: The department says it is accepting applications now. You ask for an application after four visits.

name: Teens Leading Change (TLC)
org: City of Tampa Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Weekly meetings, group talks, sports, art, life skills and community service projects at city rec centers. Trained leaders run them.
deadline_text: Ongoing at ten city centers.

what_you_do: A college and career program. It has goal setting, mentors and service projects. It also has tours of colleges and trade schools and visits to workplaces.
deadline_text: Enrollment begins in September for the school year.

name: Teen Leaders Club
what_you_do: A leadership and community service club that lasts a year. Teens lead service projects, get leadership training and help with YMCA programs.
deadline_text: Join any time through your local Y family center.

name: SI@UCF AI, Robotics, and Entrepreneurship
what_you_do: One week day program with hands-on projects on AI, robotics and entrepreneurship. Cost is $350.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 8 to 12. Summer 2027 dates will be announced in January.

name: SI@UCF Computer Science
what_you_do: Three week weekday program on the basics of computer science and computer technology, 9:00 am to 4:30 pm on campus. The cost is $1,250.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 1 to 19. Summer 2027 dates will be announced in January, and applications open in the spring.

name: Florida Youth Institute
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 1 week stay on campus. You study life science, biology engineering, natural resources and Florida farms. You may qualify for a UF scholarship. It is worth $7,500.
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Gator Artificial Intelligence Camp
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 2 week camp where you stay on campus. You learn Python basics and AI tools to solve problems and study data. You also look at how AI affects society and tour UF AI labs.
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Gator Vet Camp
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 1 week camp where you stay on campus. Talented high school students learn about animal medicine and college life. They see rare fields like wildlife and fish care.
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 27, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates are not posted.

deadline_text: Apply online any time; then an interview and health screening.

deadline_text: The page title says Summer 2026, but the dates read like 2027 (application Jan 4 to Jan 22, interviews April 6 to 8, orientation Friday June 18, program June 21 to Aug 5, 2027). Treat dates as unconfirmed.

name: Research Immersion in Science and Engineering (RISE)

deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due March 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A 7 week program where you stay on campus. You work on a UF professor's research, go to a lecture series and take an honors class.
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due March 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Greet and guide patients, help them use elevators and get rides in the main lobby and clinics. This is a summer placement.
deadline_text: For 2026, applications were open Feb 1 to April 1, 2026. The page says the summer application is now closed. No 2027 window is posted.

name: USF-Moffitt Explorers Oncology Program
org: University of South Florida with Moffitt Cancer Center
what_you_do: A 1 week day program with hands on work, practice cases, tours and talks with health staff. You learn how cancer is found, treated and studied.
deadline_text: No 2026 sessions remain. The page says registration for all 2027 summer programs opens February 1, 2027.

what_you_do: Weekly Thursday sessions on city farming, green living and nature leadership for high school students. Members get a monthly stipend and service hours.
deadline_text: The deadline for 2026-27 was Sunday, September 13, 2026. Watch the page for next year.

what_you_do: Train to teach guests about zoo animals. Practice public speaking. Help with zoo jobs like making animal meals and the giraffe feeding platform.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. They reopen March 2, 2027.

what_you_do: Join a volunteer shift in a warehouse. You check that food is safe and pack family-size boxes. You sort and repack produce and groceries. You also label containers.

name: UMSL Bridge Program Summer Academy
org: University of Missouri-St. Louis, Office of Precollegiate Student Services
what_you_do: Weekday mornings from mid June to mid July on the UMSL campus. Freshmen and sophomores get math, science and writing workshops and career planning.
deadline_text: The 2026 extended deadline was May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: High School Summer Launch
org: Washington University in St. Louis Pre-College Programs
what_you_do: A summer program with no college credit. It has lectures, workshops and college advice from WashU teachers. You can live on campus or travel in each day.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not posted on the program pages.

name: High School Summer Scholars Program
org: Washington University in St. Louis Pre-College Programs
what_you_do: A 5 week summer program for rising seniors. You take WashU college classes for college credit. You also get college readiness lessons. You can live on campus, travel in each day or take it online.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not posted on the program pages.

name: Summer Focus (Young Scientist Program)
org: Washington University in St. Louis, Young Scientist Program
what_you_do: Work in a WashU lab on a biomedical research project with a mentor and a tutor. You also take classes on science communication and college prep. You speak at a closing symposium.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 2, 2026. Due Jan 25, 2027. Recommendation letters due Feb 1, 2027.

name: Zoo ALIVE (Active Leaders in Volunteer Education)
what_you_do: Teen volunteer educators all year. They help staff run zoo camps, classes and overnights. They also help with nature projects.
deadline_text: Application opens Jan 1 and is due Feb 15 each year ((year inferred from the next cycle)). Group interview on the first Sunday of March. Notified in mid-April.

name: ZooTeens
what_you_do: Summer teen volunteers greet guests as Junior Ambassadors. Or they talk about animals as Junior Docents. Or they work in the Safari Gift Shop.
deadline_text: 2026 interview spots were filled. Page says check back in February 2027 for next summer.

name: Stonecrest Next Gen Youth Leadership Program
what_you_do: Meet one Saturday a month. You meet city leaders and learn how city government works. You also learn about public safety and leadership. You learn about community and economic development. One trip is to the Georgia State Capitol.
deadline_text: The city's Sept. 3, 2026 notice says registration opens that day. No deadline is listed. It closes when all 30 spots are filled. Sessions: Oct 24, Nov 14, Dec 12, 2026; Jan 30, Feb (Capitol date to be set), Mar 20, 2027.

name: Student U (Durham)
what_you_do: Year-round support for students who would be the first in their family to go to college. You get after-school and summer programs and tutoring. You also get college advice, leadership building and career exploration. It runs from 6th grade through college.
deadline_text: New student applications open October 20, 2026. Materials are due in January (the page gives no day or year). Information session in December.

name: Dual Enrollment at Technical College System of Georgia colleges
org: Technical College System of Georgia (including Atlanta Technical College)
what_you_do: Take college and career courses at a technical college while in high school and earn high school and college credit at the same time. Funding covers tuition, fees and books for the first 30 hours.
deadline_text: Each college sets deadlines. Atlanta Technical College lists June 1 for fall, Nov 1 for spring and April 1 for summer (no year stated).

name: Tennessee 4-H Roundup and All Star Conference
what_you_do: High school 4-H members compete in project judging. They go to workshops and a career fair. They do service and leadership tasks. They also vote in 4-H state council elections.
deadline_text: Registration day is Monday, July 19, 2027. Roundup ends Thursday evening, July 22, 2027.

name: Tennessee 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or project through your county Extension office. Teens can do projects and camps. They can lead and serve their community. They can also run for state leader jobs.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Sign up through your county Extension office.

name: Tennessee FFA
what_you_do: FFA is part of your farm and food class. Members build leadership and job skills. They do chapter events, contests, camps and a state convention.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join through your school's agricultural education class.

grades: Next year's high school juniors and seniors
name: Tennessee Forestry Camp
org: Tennessee Forestry Association with the Tennessee Department of Agriculture and Tennessee FFA
city: Pikeville, TN (Fall Creek Falls State Park)
what_you_do: Spend a week outdoors with pro foresters. Learn to name trees, measure them, use a compass and count steps. Learn about wildlife, fire safety, water quality and GPS maps.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was May 31 to June 5, 2026 with applications due May 8. 60 campers are accepted first come, first served by postmark. 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.

name: Tennessee Leadership Summit
org: Tennessee Farm Bureau Federation and UT Herbert College of Agriculture
what_you_do: Spend a week in UT dorms. You meet student leaders from across Tennessee. You learn about leading, teamwork, service and Tennessee farming. The week ends with a banquet on Friday.
deadline_text: Summit is May 31 to June 4, 2027. The page says the application is coming soon. No deadline is posted.

name: Model United Nations (YMCA of Middle Tennessee)
org: YMCA of Middle Tennessee, Center for Civic Engagement
what_you_do: Play a delegate for a United Nations member country. Write and debate world resolutions. High school students can also join the Security Council. They can lead teams. They can argue cases in the International Court of Justice.
deadline_text: High school conferences in Murfreesboro: Nov 6 to 8, Nov 13 to 15 and Nov 20 to 22, 2026. Middle school one-day events: Chattanooga Oct 22, Murfreesboro Nov 16, Memphis Dec 2, 2026. No registration deadline is posted.

name: Youth in Government (YMCA of Middle Tennessee)
org: YMCA of Middle Tennessee, Center for Civic Engagement
what_you_do: Act as a state senator or representative. Write mock bills and debate in committees at the State Capitol. High school students can also serve as lobbyists, Supreme Court lawyers or judges, press corps or heads of state offices.
deadline_text: 2027 high school conferences: Capitol Conference Feb 25 to 28, Tristar Conference Apr 8 to 11, Volunteer Conference Apr 15 to 18. Middle school: Chattanooga Mar 11 and 12 (other dates not posted yet). No registration deadline is posted.

name: Youth Tree Team
what_you_do: Do paid green jobs with Trees Atlanta staff to get hands-on experience. Weekly sessions teach job-search skills and money basics.
grades: Currently in high school or about to start high school
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: opened Nov 15, 2025, closed Feb 2, 2026, job ran June 1 to July 17, 2026. The page says 2027 details are coming later.

name: Tucker Youth Council
what_you_do: Meet monthly, September to April, with city leaders. Explore civic issues, serve as ambassadors for peers, and learn how local government works. Members commit to a full year term.
deadline_text: The 2026 council application closed Aug 19, 2026. Meetings: 9/16, 10/21, 11/18, 1/20, 2/24, 3/17, 4/21, with optional dinner 4/26 and celebration 5/7. The next application is not posted.

grades: Current 9th, 10th and 11th graders (rising sophomores, juniors, seniors)
name: AgriQuest Youth Summer Camp
org: University of Georgia College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
what_you_do: Live on the UGA campus for seven days. Join workshops, hands-on labs and talks on farming, food and nature science. Meet people in the job fields.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 2, 2026 and close March 5, 2027. Decisions by March 19, 2027. Camp is June 6 to 12, 2027.

grades: Finished sophomore year of high school (first time in the program)
name: Young Scholars Program (UGA College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences)
org: University of Georgia, College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
city: Athens, Griffin or Tifton, GA (UGA campuses)
what_you_do: This is a paid summer research internship. Students work 30 hours a week on supervised research with a UGA faculty mentor. Then they present a poster at a research conference.
deadline_text: Last cycle: application opened Nov 3, 2025 and closed Jan 23, 2026. The program page now says the application is closed for this cycle. Next cycle dates not posted.

grades: Rising high school seniors (going into senior year), Georgia students
name: Georgia Ready Summer Institute (UGA)
org: University of Georgia, Office of Academic and Community Engagement
what_you_do: This is a one week program living on the UGA campus. Students explore research and learn about entrepreneurship. They build public speaking skills. They tour research labs.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed (the application page says the deadline passed). Dates for the next cycle are not posted. Contact oace@uga.edu for future application cycles.

name: ESTEEM/SER-Quest Summer Program
org: A. James Clark School of Engineering, University of Maryland (Center for Minorities in Science and Engineering)
what_you_do: This is a 4-week summer program for rising seniors. You commute. It focuses on research. You learn about UMD engineering, research mentoring and the college application process.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 29, 2026; teacher recommendations due Apr 9, 2026; program Jul 7 to Jul 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Terp Young Scholars
org: University of Maryland, College Park (Extended Studies)
what_you_do: You take one 3-credit University of Maryland course. It lasts three weeks in the summer. You can take it on campus or online. You learn alongside regular UMD undergraduates.
deadline_text: The program dates page says the window opens January 6 and closes June 1 (no year printed; (year inferred from the next cycle)). The 2026 program ran July 13 to 31, 2026.

name: Explore@UNC
what_you_do: This is a one-week, day-only college experience. It is on the UNC campus. You pick an academic track. You take part in classes and activities.
deadline_text: Not open yet. Pre-registration is planned for mid-December 2026 through mid-January 2027; the page gives no exact opening or closing day. Financial aid paperwork is due January 28, 2027. Placement notices come in early February 2027.

name: UNC Summer School Visitor (rising high school seniors)
what_you_do: Take a regular UNC course for college credit in Summer Session 2. You sit in class with UNC students and adults.
deadline_text: The 2027 online application is not open yet and the page lists no opening date. Second Session deadlines: June 3 for rising high school seniors (all documents due), June 15 for other summer visitors. Decision letters begin March 2027.

name: UVA Advance Pre-College Program
org: University of Virginia Summer and Special Academic Programs
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential program on UVA's campus. Rising juniors and seniors take one core class and one elective. Classes give letter grades and six transferable credits. The program also has college readiness workshops.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened December 1; deadline March 1, 2026; teacher recommendation March 4; decisions March 31; accept by April 15. No 2027 dates posted yet.

name: UVA Health Junior Volunteer Summer Program
what_you_do: This is eight weeks of summer volunteering. It is at UVA Health's Charlottesville hospital. It is for high school students. You do a full-day training. You do at least 50 hours of service. There is an interview.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: interest form due February 20, 2026; info sessions February 25 and March 7, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Virginia 4-H
org: Virginia Cooperative Extension (Virginia Tech and Virginia State University)
city: Statewide, Virginia (a local Extension office in each area)
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club, camp or project and learn by doing. Leadership, citizenship and life skills are taught through projects, camps, and county, state and national events.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs, camps and events set their own dates.

grades: Finished grade 11, with at least one semester of high school left
name: Virginia Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Virginia
city: Virginia (college campus; the 2026 session was the 83rd)
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend 51st state. Delegates join a party, run for office, work in city, county and state government, and hear speakers from real government.
deadline_text: 2027 session dates and sign-up dates are not posted yet. The 2026 session ran June 21 to 27, 2026. Local American Legion posts pick delegates earlier in the school year.

grades: Finished grade 11, with at least one semester of high school left
name: Virginia Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Virginia
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Girls learn how Virginia government works by doing it, with elections, bills and daily sessions.
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 25, 2027. The site lists April 15, 2027 for fees to reach district registrars, May 15, 2027 for all delegates registered, and June 1, 2027 for online forms. A date to apply to your local unit is not posted.

name: Virginia House of Delegates Page Program
org: Virginia House of Delegates, Clerk's Office
what_you_do: Work as a House Page for the whole 2027 legislative session in Richmond. Pages deliver documents and run errands. They help committees and the Clerk's Office. They also take part in leadership and civics training.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 session close Friday, Oct 16, 2026 at 3 p.m. Eastern. Selected pages are usually told by email before Thanksgiving.

name: Senate of Virginia Page Program
what_you_do: Serve as a Senate Page for a whole legislative session. Pages staff committee meetings and answer phones. They deliver bill copies and help visitors. They do leadership training and a community service project.
deadline_text: The class of 2027 application closed Oct 1, 2026. The class of 2028 application opens July 1, 2027 and closes at 5 p.m. on Oct 1, 2027. Decisions usually come in mid-December.

grades: Entering 9th grade (freshman year) at least; still in high school the next fall
name: Virginia State Parks Youth Conservation Corps
org: Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation, State Parks
what_you_do: Live in a bunkhouse at a state park for two weeks. You work on trail upkeep, small building projects and other conservation work. Park rangers lead evening programs and outdoor activities.
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Jan 1, 2027 and close Mar 19, 2027 at 5 p.m. Interviews Mar 30 to Apr 8, offers Apr 16, 2027.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Virginia Wing
city: Statewide, Virginia (squadrons from Winchester to Virginia Beach)
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Teens meet weekly with a local squadron and can go to the wing's summer encampment.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can join any time through a local squadron.

name: Museum Teen Internship (Summer Service Program)
what_you_do: High school interns can work as Gallery Helpers. They greet visitors and talk with children. Or they can be Summer Camp Assistants. They greet campers, set up activities, supervise playtime and lunch hour.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 are closed. The 2027 deadline is not posted.

name: Camp Woods and Wildlife
what_you_do: Spend a week at a forest camp. Take outdoor classes on forests, wildlife, how to name trees and forest care. Try a lumberjack field day, canoeing and archery.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 15 to 19, 2026. The page says 2027 information and the application will be posted in February. Applicants are told starting in March.

name: Virginia Envirothon
org: Virginia Association of Soil and Water Conservation Districts
what_you_do: Teams of five high school students are tested on soil, forests, wildlife, water life and a current issue. The tests are at field stations. Teams also give a talk.
deadline_text: Page says to contact your local district by winter for spring local or regional contests. The state contest is held in mid to late May. The top three teams from each of six areas advance.

name: Virginia Governor's School for Agriculture
org: Virginia Department of Education, hosted by Virginia Tech
what_you_do: Spend three weeks at Virginia Tech in classroom, lab and field work on agriculture. Take core and chosen courses, learn about careers, and do a group project.
deadline_text: 2026 session ran June 20 to July 11, 2026. Deadlines vary by school division. 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.

grades: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders)
name: Summer Residential Governor's School for Medicine and Health Sciences
org: Radford University and Blue Ridge Partnership for Health Science Careers, with Carilion Clinic
what_you_do: About three weeks of hands-on healthcare learning: visit healthcare providers, health education institutions and research labs, practice CPR, work at a free clinic, and meet faculty and students.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not found on the program pages. Ask your school counselor.

grades: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders)
name: Summer Residential Governor's School for Visual & Performing Arts and Humanities
org: Radford University and the Virginia Department of Education
what_you_do: A summer residential program in Radford for visual and performing arts and humanities. The $300 activity fee covers outings, enrichment activities and field trips.
deadline_text: Dates and deadline for the next session were not found on the program pages. Ask your school counselor.

name: Youth Conservation Corps (Shenandoah National Park)
org: National Park Service, Shenandoah National Park
what_you_do: Work on a summer crew in a national park on conservation projects. The page lists these jobs. Build trails. Fix fences. Clean campgrounds. Improve wildlife habitat. Restore streams. Save historic buildings.
deadline_text: 2026 last day to apply was April 24, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: C-Tech2: Computers and Technology at Virginia Tech
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, Center for Engineering Excellence and Discovery
what_you_do: This is a two-week residential summer program on the Blacksburg campus. You live on campus. It includes a biomedical engineering design project. You also learn about other engineering fields. You get a look at college life.
deadline_text: Page says applications for Summer 2027 open in early December 2026. No closing date posted.

name: College of Science Summer Camps (Explore Science camps)
what_you_do: These are week-long residential science camps. They have hands-on labs and experiments. In 2026, high school camps were Explore Science for rising 9th and 10th graders. Explore Life Science and Explore Physical Science were for rising 11th and 12th graders.
grades: Rising 9th to 12th (Explore Science 9-10; Life and Physical Science camps 11-12)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application portal opened January 2026; deadline for first round of applications March 2. Offers of admission and scholarships made by March 16; accepted campers have until March 30 to pay fees (minus scholarships).

name: Upward Bound (Virginia Tech)
what_you_do: Get free tutoring, college prep workshops, career ideas and college trips during the school year. You also get a summer program of up to six weeks on the Virginia Tech campus.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Use the application form for your school.

name: Watford Engineering Experience at Virginia Tech (WEE VT)
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, Center for Engineering Excellence and Discovery
what_you_do: This is a two-week residential summer program. It is on the Blacksburg campus. You do hands-on engineering activities. Faculty give talks. You also get college application sessions.
deadline_text: Page says applications for Summer 2027 open in early December. No closing date posted. 2026 program ran Jul 12 to Jul 25, 2026.

name: VASTS: Virginia Aerospace Science and Technology Scholars
org: Virginia Space Grant Consortium with NASA Langley Research Center
city: Hampton, VA (online course, summer academy at NASA Langley)
what_you_do: Take a free online space and STEM course during the school year. Top scholars can be picked for a six-day summer academy at NASA Langley. Teams there design a crewed mission to Mars and meet NASA engineers.
deadline_text: The page says apply by October 24, 2026. It also lists online course applications as open August 15 to October 25 (a different date), so apply by October 24 to be safe.

name: Virginia Youth Conservation Camp
org: Virginia Association of Soil and Water Conservation Districts
what_you_do: Spend a week at Virginia Tech learning about Virginia's natural resources. You do hands-on outdoor activities. Nature experts and Virginia Tech teachers lead them. About 70 students go.
deadline_text: Applications for July 2027 open in early 2027. In 2026 the state page listed May 4 as the application due date, and local districts set their own earlier or later dates.

name: Career and College Promise (dual enrollment at Wake Tech)
what_you_do: Take college classes tuition-free while in high school, in more than 40 academic programs. Many courses also count for high school graduation. Choose college transfer or career and technical.
deadline_text: Dates change each term. See the Events and Important Deadlines calendar on the Wake Tech CCP site. The page lists no specific dates.

grades: Juniors or seniors (the page intro says current and rising seniors)
name: Careers Electric High School Summer Academy
org: Wake Tech Community College with Wake County Public School System
what_you_do: A six-week summer academy. Classes are Monday to Wednesday at the Wake Tech Southern Wake Campus. On Thursday and Friday you train on the job with a local electrical employer.
deadline_text: The 2026 application window has closed. Check back for information on the 2027 Summer Academy. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: WakeWorks Youth Apprenticeship Academy
org: Wake Tech Community College with Wake County Public School System
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors learn on the job in skilled trades, car and truck tech, or advanced making of goods. In year two you work for a partner employer. You are a paid Registered Youth Apprentice.
deadline_text: Applications are being accepted for Spring 2027. Application deadline is October 16 (2026).

name: WakeMed Junior Volunteer Program (High School)
what_you_do: High school students volunteer one set day each week. They serve at a WakeMed campus for at least six months. Openings are competitive. They are posted only when positions are open.
grades: High school, through the summer after graduation
deadline_text: Applications open for only about 24 to 48 hours. The page says the next application check date is October 15, 2026, and to check on the 15th of October, December, February, April, June and August. On 2026-10-10 the page showed both campuses as CURRENT STATUS: CLOSED.

name: Wellstar Cobb Medical Center VolunTeen Program
org: Wellstar Health System, Cobb Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital one weekday shift a week over the summer. Tasks include helping guests, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical or non-clinical departments.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 31, 2026, interviews in March or April, program June 4 to July 29, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Wellstar Kennestone Hospital VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. Tasks include customer service, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical and non-clinical departments. It is one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks.
deadline_text: Application window Feb 1 to 15, forms due Feb 28. The page does not print a year, so treat this as the yearly pattern and check for 2027.

name: VolunTeens at Wellstar North Fulton Hospital
org: Wellstar Health System, North Fulton Hospital (Roswell)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. You work one two-hour shift each week for six of the eight summer weeks.
deadline_text: Applications open each February, interviews in March, orientation in April. The page does not give a 2027 closing date.

name: Youth R.I.S.E. (Reaching Independence through Skills and Employment)
org: WorkSource Atlanta (City of Atlanta workforce board)
what_you_do: This is free help for Atlanta youth all year. You get paid work experience and internships. You get job readiness workshops. You get GED or high school support. You can take short training that leads to credentials.
deadline_text: Year-round, first come first served. After the online orientation you have 30 days to submit all documents or your application may be closed.

name: WorkSource DeKalb Youth Services (WIOA)
what_you_do: Career planning, help finishing high school or a GED, skills training and a paid work experience placement, with a mentor and job placement help. Free.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline and does not say whether enrollment is ongoing. Apply online at ATLworks.org; an eligibility specialist replies within 7 business days.

name: WorkSource Fulton Youth Services
what_you_do: This is year-round job readiness training. It includes GED and high school diploma help. You can get paid work experience and transportation help. You also get occupational skills training. It is for Fulton County youth.
deadline_text: Year-round. No application dates are posted.

name: Teen Leaders Club and Changemakers
what_you_do: Join Leaders Club or Changemakers. In Leaders Club, teens lead projects, plan events, do service projects, and connect with mentors. It can include travel to conferences. In Changemakers, teens work on causes they care about, with advocacy and public speaking.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Register on the Y site or at your local branch.

name: YMCA Leaders Club (Middle and High School)
city: Chapel Hill and the Triangle, NC
what_you_do: This is a year-long leadership and community service club for teens. It meets at local YMCA branches. Members get leadership training. They volunteer with Y programs.
grades: 6-12 (Middle School Leaders Club grades 6-8; High School Leaders Club grades 9-12)
deadline_text: No registration deadline stated. Clubs start in early fall; A.E. Finley YMCA lists interest meetings Sept. 15 and 16 (year not stated).

name: Lightner Y Achievers
what_you_do: Teens meet in small groups. They explore education and career options. They do community service. They take college and industry tours.
deadline_text: No application or registration deadline stated. College tour registration opens in early 2027.

name: Volunteen Program (Zoo Atlanta)
what_you_do: Serve at the Zoo for a full program year in areas like habitat interpretation, public events, conservation projects, Safari Camp and animal nutrition. Training week is required.
deadline_text: Applications open 9 a.m. Jan 1 and close 5 p.m. Jan 31 (the page prints no year; it is for the June 2027 program year, so Jan 2027). A free Program Preview is Nov 14, 10 a.m. to noon, with registration.
